estimate_note: Best practice items (RCDs, smoke alarms, AS 3740 waterproofing, TMVs, termite barrier, step-free entry) are priced in.
standards: Seismic design of buildings: zone factor Z, soil type, R and Ω factors, regularity, drift
Mandatory rules of thumb for RC buildings without an engineer (≤ 3 storeys): column ≥ 300×300 (350 common for G+2), spans ≤ 4.5 m, slab ≥ 125 mm, cantilever ≤ 1 m, detailing
Architectural design requirements: minimum room sizes, heights, light and ventilation
Fire safety; no openings on boundary walls; setbacks, ground coverage, FAR and light plane per the municipality
Sanitary and plumbing: traps, vents, septic and soak pit
H4 light, ventilation, heights; H5 stairs and balustrades; H6 energy; window restrictors (H5D4)
Wiring rules: RCDs on every final circuit, bathroom zones, earthing, SPD
Plumbing and drainage: grades, venting, backflow, TMVs at 50 °C
Waterproofing of wet areas: shower floors and walls to 1.8 m, upturns, falls
Battery systems, grid-connected inverters, PV arrays
Smoke alarms: interconnected, 230 V with battery backup
Gas installations: LPG cylinder outside, hob clearances
Step-free entry, 820 mm clear doors, reinforced bathroom walls, WC door outward or sliding
Glass in buildings (Grade A safety glass in human-impact zones), windows
